condiments.name: Picnic Lab
condiments.description: Optional fictional external-agent playground: discovery, events, callable capabilities, receipts, and real Snack/agent actions. Simulation is clearly labeled; no external account or key required.

commands.name: picnic-connect
commands.description: Connect or disconnect the local simulation.

commands.name: picnic-scenario
commands.description: Select a demonstration; the underlying Snack registry remains unrestricted by the scenario.

commands.name: picnic-discover
commands.description: Search the complete live Snack capability registry.

commands.name: picnic-event
commands.description: Simulate an external event. No real effect runs automatically.

commands.name: picnic-app-command
commands.description: Call the fictional app echo capability.

commands.name: picnic-message
commands.description: Send a message to the scripted fictional agent.

commands.name: picnic-call
commands.description: Invoke any discovered Snack API/MCP tool through the reviewed Condiment harness. Caller must hold this module’s approved grants.

commands.name: picnic-chipclip
commands.description: Create and save an independent real ChipClip; preserves Main Snack Pasta.

commands.name: picnic-agent-message
commands.description: Send once to a selected real named Snack agent. May use its provider account.

commands.name: picnic-agent-replies
commands.description: Read new replies from the demo’s real Snack conversation.

commands.name: picnic-roundtrip
commands.description: Simulate a threaded chat reply and replay the same reply ID.

commands.name: picnic-delegation
commands.description: Simulate one correlated external-agent to internal-agent handoff.

commands.name: picnic-receipt-batch
commands.description: Simulate retaining tool receipts and issuing one batched notification.

agent.instructions: Picnic Lab is a scripted local simulation, not a real model or external network service. Discover its declared commands with condiment-agent-guide. Humans, local agents and remote agents with the full approved module grants use the same handlers. picnic-call can use any live discovered Snack tool subject to caller/module grants. Do not imply the demo used a real key or external backend. Actual Snack effects and model messages happen only when explicitly requested.

skills.name: Picnic Lab scenarios
skills.description: Exercise external-agent workflows through the same Condiment commands.
